cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Preconditions: Save password dialog box is displayed for a site. Action: Select Never For This Site. Expected: The browser discards the password.

cases.title: Present multiple saved usernames and passwords
cases.description: Preconditions: Multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved in the password manager. Action: Navigate to the website login page and invoke credential selection. Expected: All saved choices are available to be presented.

cases.title: Update password manager when password is changed
cases.description: Preconditions: A username and password for a website are saved. Action: Change the password on the website and save or log in with the new password. Expected: The password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Disable password manager in preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: Password manager is disabled from the preferences panel. Action: Navigate to a login site and attempt to trigger save prompts or prefilled info. Expected: The browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved credentials in preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: A username and password in the password manager are saved. Action: Open the password manager through preferences. Expected: The saved information is visible in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove specific site credentials
cases.description: Preconditions: A username and password for a given site are saved. Action: Remove the credentials for that site from the password manager. Expected: The credentials no longer autofill on that site nor are they listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all saved credentials
cases.description: Preconditions: Multiple username and password information entries are saved. Action: Remove all username and password information. Expected: No credentials autofill on any site and nothing is listed in the password manager.
